Helper function: get_non_r_packages

Source: R/get_non_r_packages.R
get_non_r_packages.Rd

Helper function: get_non_r_packages

Usage

get_non_r_packages()

Value

returns vector with KWB-R repos on Github, which are not R packages

Examples

get_non_r_packages()
